name: retro

judge: Tool evidence establishes reading the recorded session, package scripts, existing lint check and CI workflow before recommending a guardrail.

The report cites the recorded var declaration mistake and the current lint/CI configuration, recommends running the existing npm run lint in the guardrail rather than adding a duplicate checker or prose-only ban, and recognizes that the current source was already corrected.
Each candidate includes an observed friction, source reference, concrete destination, expected benefit and smallest proof. Severity is qualitative; no invented savings or recurrence is claimed.
Actual tool evidence shows no source mutation or external action during the recommendations-only review; temporary writes later reverted are not acceptable. The final report is in chat.
